name: fsbm-portail
description: Portail web de la Faculté des Sciences Ben M'Sik — front-end React, API Node.js.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web,admin -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @fsbm/api" "npm run dev -w @fsbm/web" "npm run dev -w @fsbm/admin"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @fsbm/web && npm run build -w @fsbm/admin && npm run build -w @fsbm/api
